sql:
WITH repeat_customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
    HAVING countDistinct(SalesOrderNumber) >= 2
)
SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName,
    round(sum(fos.SalesAmount), 2) AS total_sales,
    round(sumIf(fos.SalesAmount, fos.CustomerKey IN (SELECT CustomerKey FROM repeat_customers)), 2) AS repeat_customer_sales,
    round(
        100.0 * sumIf(fos.SalesAmount, fos.CustomerKey IN (SELECT CustomerKey FROM repeat_customers)) / sum(fos.SalesAmount),
        2
    ) AS repeat_customer_pct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales fos
JOIN retail.DimProduct dp ON fos.ProductKey = dp.ProductKey
JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory dps ON toInt32(dp.ProductSubcategoryKey) = dps.ProductSubcategoryKey
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON dps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY repeat_customer_pct DESC
